crossRefs.note: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in…
Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you…
Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…

translations.web: when you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.
translations.bsb: because you obey the LORD your God, keeping all His commandments I am giving you today and doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: when thou shalt hearken to the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah thy God.
